# Messaging Firebase Model

## Purpose
The Messaging Firebase Model defines entities specific to Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) integration, such as Firebase tokens and configurations.

## Key Entities
- **FirebaseEnabledDevice**: Links a system user or device to a Firebase Cloud Messaging token.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- FirebaseEnabledDevice
    class FirebaseEnabledDevice {
        +String token
        +Baseclass relatedEntity
    }
```
